text: This demolition permit application is submitted to City Council for consideration and decision to grant or grant with conditions, approval of the demolition permit application, including the requirement for the owner to enter into a beautification agreement prior to the issuance of the demolition permit. This property is located in the former City of York and in accordance with By-law No. 3102-95 of the former City of York. On February 5th, 2018, Toronto Building received a demolition permit application to demolish a one storey vacant commercial building located at 3385 Dundas Street West. A building permit application for a replacement building has not been received. The building is located within Ward 13 – Parkdale – High Park.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council refuse the application to demolish a one-storey vacant commercial building at 3385 Dundas Street West because a building permit has not been issued for a replacement building on this site.
